name: Delete Leads
summary: Permanently deletes lead records by their Marketo IDs. Up to 300 per call.
whenToUse: Rarely — for cleaning up test records or records you are certain should be gone. There is no undo and no 'trash' in Marketo.
confirm: This PERMANENTLY deletes up to 300 lead records (all their data and activity). This cannot be undone. Continue?

body.hint: The Marketo lead IDs to delete, comma-separated.

response.description: One status per lead ID: deleted or skipped (with a reason).

notes: IDs that don't exist are skipped, not an error.
Deleting a lead does not delete their activities — those remain in the activity log.
